modules.title: Introduction to Islamic Civilisation and Contemporary Issues
modules.html:
The contributions of Islamic civilisation to science, education and culture, and Islam's response to modern challenges. This section covers introduction to islamic civilisation and contemporary issues.

Key points

  • The 'Year of Elephant' (Amul-Fil) is significant in Islamic history because it was the year _____. — the Prophet was born.
  • The pre-Islamic period of ignorance in Arabia is known as _____. — Jahiliyyah.
  • The Islamic term for the 'oneness of God' is _____. — Tawhid.
  • The pre-Islamic period in Arabian history is known as... — Al-Jahiliyyah.

Worked examples

Q: The 'Year of Elephant' (Amul-Fil) is significant in Islamic history because it was the year _____.
A: the Prophet was born — Prophet Muhammad (SAW) was born in Makkah in 570 CE, the same year Abrahah attempted to destroy the Ka'bah with an army of elephants.

Q: The pre-Islamic period of ignorance in Arabia is known as _____.
A: Jahiliyyah — Jahiliyyah refers to the state of affairs in Arabia before the mission of Prophet Muhammad (SAW), characterized by idolatry and tribal warfare.

quiz.q: The 'Year of Elephant' (Amul-Fil) is significant in Islamic history because it was the year _____.
options: the first battle of Islam occurred
quiz.solution: Prophet Muhammad (SAW) was born in Makkah in 570 CE, the same year Abrahah attempted to destroy the Ka'bah with an army of elephants.

quiz.q: The pre-Islamic period of ignorance in Arabia is known as _____.
quiz.solution: Jahiliyyah refers to the state of affairs in Arabia before the mission of Prophet Muhammad (SAW), characterized by idolatry and tribal warfare.

quiz.q: The Islamic term for the 'oneness of God' is _____.
quiz.solution: Tawhid is the defining doctrine of Islam.

quiz.q: The pre-Islamic period in Arabian history is known as...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Al-Jahiliyyah.

quiz.q: The companion who was known as 'Dhul-Nurayn' (The possessor of two lights) was _____.
quiz.solution: Uthman b. Affan was given this title because he married two of the Prophet's daughters, Ruqayyah and Umm Kulthum.

quiz.q: The term 'Shirk' means _____.
quiz.solution: Shirk is the opposite of Tawhid and is considered the gravest sin in Islam, as it compromises the absolute oneness of God.

quiz.q: A prayer offered for a deceased Muslim before burial is called _____.
quiz.solution: Salat al-Janazah is a funeral prayer consisting of four Takbirs, performed in congregation standing up (without Ruku' or Sujud).

quiz.q: The direction (Qiblah) Muslims face during prayer was changed from _____ to Makkah.
quiz.solution: Early in Madinah, the Qiblah was toward Masjid al-Aqsa in Jerusalem before the revelation of Surat al-Baqarah verse 144.

quiz.q: The 'Al-Faruq' was the title of which Caliph?
quiz.solution: Umar was called Al-Faruq (The one who distinguishes between truth and falsehood) for his strict justice.

quiz.q: A 'Mushrik' is a person who _____.
quiz.solution: The term comes from 'Shirk', meaning polytheism or idolatry.

quiz.q: Which Caliph was known for compiling the standard version of the Qur'an?
quiz.solution: Uthman (RA) ordered the standardization of the Qur'anic text to ensure uniformity across the expanding empire.

quiz.q: The 'Dower' or Mahr belongs to _____.
quiz.solution: Mahr is the exclusive property of the bride, and neither her husband nor her parents can take it without her consent.

quiz.q: Makkan Surahs focus on:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Tawhid/Faith.

quiz.q: Fajr rakat:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 2.

quiz.q: First wife:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Khadijah.

quiz.q: Compiled Quran:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Uthman/Abu Bakr.

quiz.q: Book of Dawud:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Zabur.

quiz.q: Jumuah prayer is on:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Friday.

quiz.q: The compilation of the Quran into a book form was completed during the caliphate of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Uthman.

quiz.q: Maliki, Hanafi, Shafi'i, and Hanbali are schools of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Fiqh (Jurisprudence).

quiz.q: The angels recording deeds are called:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Kiraman Katibin.

quiz.q: Al-Khulafa ar-Rashidun means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: The Rightly Guided Caliphs.

quiz.q: Ijma refers to:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Consensus of scholars.

quiz.q: The Battle of Uhud was lost because:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Archers left their post.

quiz.q: Dry ablution performed with clean sand or dust when water is unavailable is called...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Tayammum.

quiz.q: The angel responsible for bringing revelations to the Prophets is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Jibril.

quiz.q: Fasting in the month of Ramadan is called:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Sawm.

quiz.q: The Kiblah direction is towards:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Kaaba (Makkah).

quiz.q: Wudu is invalid after:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Sleeping.

quiz.q: Wudu involves washing:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Face, Hands, Head, Feet.

quiz.q: Battle of Uhud:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Muslims suffered loss.

quiz.q: Nikah is:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Marriage contract.

quiz.q: Laylat al-Qadr is better than:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: 1000 months.

quiz.q: Ayat al-Kursi in:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Al-Baqarah.

quiz.q: Mother:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Aminah.

quiz.q: Isa Book:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Injil.

quiz.q: Jumuah:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Friday.

quiz.q: Associating partners with Allah is known as?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Shirk.

quiz.q: Zakat is an obligatory ___?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Alms-giving.

quiz.q: The state of purity and the dress worn during Hajj is?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Ihram.

quiz.q: The "Ulu al-Azm" (Prophets of Power/Constancy) are ___ in number?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 5.

quiz.q: The early Muslims first migrated to ___ to escape persecution?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Abyssinia (Ethiopia).

quiz.q: The "Farewell Pilgrimage" is known as?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Hajjat al-Wada'.
